Ancient trees, rare plants tell Bicol Natural Park's story
description: MANILA, Philippines — A centuries-old tree, a critically endangered plant and several rare and endemic species are among the botanical treasures documented in Bicol Natural Park during a biodiversity monitoring activity in the second half of 2026, according to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Bicol. The findings highlight the diversity of plant life within the protected area and the ecological importance of preserving its remaining forest habitats, the agency said. Among the most notable features of the park is a massive dipterocarp tree known locally as Tiaong (Shorea ovata), estimated to be between 350 and 400 years old. […]...
